newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends weaker against mark, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends weaker against mark, dollar.

text.p: 1455 GMT - The Swiss franc closed weaker against the mark as the German currency tested a topside around 82.75. The dollar rose during the day but slumped after slipping below 1.5175.
Traders said dollar/Swiss and mark/Swiss were boosted by covering for short positions taken last week.
* The dollar closed at 1.5142/5152 Swiss francs vs opening 1.5117/5127 and 1.5190/5200 at Monday's close.
* The mark ended at 82.72/73 centimes vs 82.39/41 at start and prior close of 82.26/28.
